name: New Zealand Citizens-Initiated Referendum Petitions (1994–present)
title: New Zealand Citizens-Initiated Referendum Petitions (1994–present)
description: Petitions lodged under New Zealand's Citizens Initiated Referenda Act 1993, with sponsor, the question as proposed and as determined by the Clerk of the House, key dates and outcome.

rows.sponsor: Royal New Zealand Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals
rows.question_proposed: Should the inhumane practice of battery egg production be phased out within five years from this referendum?
rows.question_determined: Should the production of eggs from battery hens be prohibited within five years of the referendum?
rows.result: Petition delivered to Clerk; Petition lapsed (insufficient signatures)

rows.question_proposed: Should a judge be given the power to decide whether life imprisonment for murder should mean a prisoner will be imprisoned for his/her natural life?
rows.question_determined: Should a Judge sentencing a person convicted of murder to life imprisonment be empowered to order that the person be imprisoned for his or her natural life and not be eligible for parole?

rows.sponsor: Michael Laws MP, Hon Winston Peters MP, Geoff Braybrooke MP
rows.question_proposed: Should the size of Parliament be reduced from 120 Members of Parliament to 100 by reducing the number of "list" MPs from 55 seats to 35 seats?
rows.question_determined: Should the size of Parliament be reduced from 120 Members of Parliament to 100 by reducing the number elected from the party list?

rows.question_proposed: All New Zealanders should have access to a non-profit public health service which is fully government funded and without user charges.
rows.result: Question withdrawn by proposer on 16 September 1994

rows.question_proposed: All new Zealanders should have access to non-profit education service that is fully government funded and without user charges, from pre-school to tertiary level.
rows.result: Question withdrawn by proposer on 16 September 1994

rows.question_proposed: The central goals of government economic policy should be full employment at liveable wages and, for those not in the paid workforce, an income based on what it actually costs to live.
rows.result: Question withdrawn by proposer on 16 September 1994

rows.question_proposed: New Zealand's military budget should be reduced to half its 1994 level by the year 2000 and the savings allocated to health, education, employment and conservation.
rows.result: Question withdrawn by proposer on 16 September 1994

rows.question_proposed: The Employment Contracts Act should be replaced with laws that deliver pay equity and are consistent with the International Labour Organisation's conventions and the United Nations' International Bill of Human Rights.
rows.result: Question withdrawn by proposer, on 16 September 1994

rows.question_proposed: Any increase in New Zealand's electricity demand should be met from energy conservation and from sources that are environmentally sustainable, and do not produce carbon dioxide (CO2).
rows.result: Question withdrawn by proposer on 16 September 1994

rows.question_proposed: Do you want a Constitutional Enactment to enable the enforcement of political accountability?
rows.question_determined: Should there be a legally enforceable requirement that political parties observe their constitution and their manifesto promises?

rows.question_proposed: Should the number of firefighters employed in the New Zealand Fire Service be reduced?
rows.question_determined: Should the number of professional fire fighters employed full-time in the New Zealand Fire Service be reduced below the number employed on 1 January 1995?
rows.result: Referendum failed. Petition successful—presented to House on 30 May 1995; select committee report on 22 June 1995; referendum held on 2 December 1995. (27.0% turnout - 12.2% yes; 87.8% no)

rows.question_proposed: Should all New Zealanders have access to public health services, which are fully government funded, and without user charges?
rows.question_determined: Should all New Zealanders have access to comprehensive health services, which are fully government funded, and without user charges?
rows.result: Delivered to Clerk, Petition lapsed (insufficient signatures)

rows.question_proposed: Should all New Zealanders have access to public education services, from early childhood to tertiary level, which are fully government funded and without user charges?
rows.question_determined: Should all New Zealanders have access to public education services, from early childhood to tertiary level, which are fully government funded and without user charges?
rows.result: Delivered to Clerk, Petition lapsed (insufficient signatures)

rows.question_proposed: Should full employment with wages and conditions that are fair and equitable be the central goal of government economic policy?
rows.question_determined: Should full employment with wages and conditions that are fair and equitable be the primary goal of government economic policy?

rows.question_proposed: Should all New Zealanders on income support and benefits get an income based on what it actually costs to live?
rows.question_determined: Should all New Zealanders on income support and benefits get an income based on what it actually costs to live?

rows.question_proposed: Should increases in New Zealand's electricity demand be met from energy conservation and from the use of resources that are environmentally sustainable?
rows.question_determined: Should increases in New Zealand's electricity demand be met from energy conservation and from the use of sources that are environmentally sustainable?

rows.question_proposed: Should New Zealand's military budget be reduced to half its 1994/1995 level by the year 2000 with the savings spent on health, education, conservation and the promotion of full employment?
rows.question_determined: Should New Zealand's defence expenditure be reduced to half its 1994/95 level by the year 2000 with the savings spent on health, education, conservation and the promotion of full employment?

rows.question_proposed: Should the laws of New Zealand apply equally to all New Zealanders irrespective of ethnic origin?
rows.question_determined: Do you agree that the laws of New Zealand should not discriminate against or give preference to citizens or permanent residents of New Zealand on the basis of their ethnic origins?

rows.sponsor: Companion and the Voluntary Euthanasia Society (Auckland) Inc
rows.question_proposed: Should voluntary euthanasia be legalised for persons 18 years and older?
rows.question_determined: Should people aged 18 years and over who are terminally or incurably ill be permitted to have their lives ended if they request this, in a humane manner and in accordance with procedures to be established?

rows.question_proposed: Should the Forestry Corporation's plantation forests, mills, and rights in perpetuity to 188,000 hectares of Crown land, remain in New Zealand public ownership?
rows.question_determined: Should the forestry licenses to 188,000 hectares of Crown forest land which are currently held by the Forestry Corporation of New Zealand Limited remain in state ownership (subject to the determination of any Treaty of Waitangi claims)?
rows.result: Delivered to Clerk; Petition lapsed (insufficient signatures)

rows.sponsor: Nga Kaitiaki o Te Waonuia Taane o Aotearoa
rows.question_proposed: Should there be a law passed banning any further destruction of the native forests of Aotearoa to preserve the last remnants of our national heritage (pursuant to the Treaty of Waitangi)?
rows.question_determined: Should all tree felling and clearing on any indigenous land (except in plantation forests and already protected conservation areas be prohibited, unless such tree felling or cleaning is in accordance with Maori customary use?

rows.question_proposed: Should the Treaty of Waitangi, being an outdated document, be set aside and replaced with a national constitution which guarantees the equal rights of all New Zealanders without favour or discrimination?
rows.question_determined: Should there be a Written Constitution, taking precedence of the Treaty of Waitangi and all other sources of law, which guarantees the right of all people without favour or discrimination?

rows.question_proposed: Should the size of Parliament be reduced from 120 members of Parliament to 99 members of Parliament by reducing the number elected from party lists?
rows.question_determined: Should the size of the House of Representatives be reduced from 120 members to 99 members?
rows.result: Referendum passed. Petition successful—presented to House on 17 February 1999; referendum held on 27 November 1999. (84.8% turnout - 81.5% yes; 18.5% no)

rows.question_proposed: That should there be an urgent reform of our Justice system to introduce restorative justice which seeks to place greater emphasis on the needs of victims and includes hard labour for all serious violent offences?
rows.question_determined: Should there be a reform of our justice system placing greater emphasis on the needs of the victims, providing restitution and compensation for them and imposing minimum sentences and hard labour for all serious violent offences?
rows.result: Referendum passed. Petition successful—presented to House on 13 July 1999; referendum held on 27 November 1999. (84.8% turnout - 91.8% yes; 8.2% no)

rows.question_proposed: That the Government should increase its annual spending on health services to at least 7% of GDP, funded if necessary from personal income tax.
rows.question_determined: Should the Government increase its annual spending on health services to at least 7% of GDP, funding the increase, if necessary, from personal income tax?

rows.question_proposed: Should the method of election be termination of the political party system with the election for the constituency candidate as representative by single transferable vote?
rows.question_determined: Should members of Parliament be elected by single transferable vote (STV) with constituency-based, multi-member electorates?
rows.result: Delivered to Clerk, Petition lapsed (insufficient signatures)

rows.question_proposed: Should the Government stop any forced school closures until there have been full and transparent guidelines and procedures adapted by Parliament?
rows.question_determined: Should there be no further compulsory school closures until comprehensive criteria have been established by law for the Minister of Education to follow when deciding to close a school?

rows.question_proposed: Do you support the request that the Government of New Zealand reduce the number of unemployed people to below 1% of the working population by the year 2004?
rows.question_determined: Should the government be required to reduce the number of unemployed people to below 1% of the labour force by the year 2004?

rows.sponsor: The Free New Zealand Party Society Inc
rows.question_proposed: Should government let New Zealanders have democracy by referendum where any individual or group can submit opinions which get numbered so we can list what we agree with and list what we disagree with, then the results are sent to four independent committees who create four separate laws and we vote for the most suitable one?
rows.question_determined: Should New Zealand adapt direct democracy by binding referendum whereby ideas for laws should be submitted and voted upon as of right by the public and, according to the result, submissions collected from the public and then assessed by opinion poll, resulting un draft law alternatives being prepared by independent groups, from which one opinion would be chosen by majority vote by the public; the resulting legislation to be binding?

rows.question_proposed: Should the Government ban the sale and distribution of tobacco products?
rows.question_determined: Should Parliament enact legislation to ban the sale and distribution of tobacco?

rows.question_proposed: Should Dr Newman's Shared Parenting Bill be made law in the Family Court?
rows.question_determined: Should the Shared Parenting Bill introduced by Dr Muriel Newman (which creates a presumption that parents who are separated or divorced will have equal rights to custody of their children) be passed by Parliament?

rows.question_proposed: Do you believe that New Zealand should hold a binding referendum on whether we should replace MMP by a return to first-past-the-post elections?
rows.result: Question withdrawn by promoter (between 2 and 8 November 2000)

rows.question_proposed: Should the current review of the voting system be taken out of the hands of self-interested politicians by holding another binding referendum to decide the future voting system, recognising the already clearly established public demand to reduce the number of MPs to 99?
rows.question_determined: Should a binding referendum be held to decide the future voting system, based on a Parliament of 99 MPs?

rows.sponsor: Ian Wishart on behalf of the Constitution Trust of New Zealand
rows.question_proposed: Should New Zealand adopt a written constitution which protects fundamental human and civil rights and which transfers legal sovereignty from the Crown to the people?
rows.question_determined: Should New Zealand adopt a written constitution expressly vesting sovereignty in the people and protecting fundamental human and civil rights?

rows.question_proposed: Should legislation be enacted to make Citizens Initiated Referenda binding on Government?
rows.question_determined: Should the law be amended to make the results of citizens initiated referenda binding on the New Zealand Government?

rows.question_proposed: Should our longstanding right of final appeal to the Privy Council in London be abolished?
rows.question_determined: Should all rights of appeal to the Privy Council be abolished?

rows.sponsor: Larry Baldock MP and Gordon Copeland MP
rows.question_proposed: That the Prostitution Law Reform Act 2003 be repealed?
rows.question_determined: Should the Prostitution Reform Act 2003 be repealed?
rows.result: Delivered to Clerk, Petition lapsed (insufficient signatures)

rows.question_proposed: Should New Zealand change its flag?
rows.question_determined: Should the design of the New Zealand flag be changed?

rows.question_proposed: Should the proprietor of a licensed establishment be able to determine whether it is a smoke-free premise?
rows.question_determined: Should the proprietor of licensed premises be able to determine whether those premises are smoke-free?

rows.question_proposed: Should the Government give urgent priority to understanding and addressing the wider causes of family breakdown, family violence and child abuse in New Zealand?
rows.question_determined: Should the Government give urgent priority to understanding and addressing the wider causes of family breakdown, family violence and child abuse in New Zealand?

rows.question_proposed: Should a smack within the context of positive parental correction be a criminal offence in New Zealand?
rows.question_determined: Should a smack as part of good parental correction be a criminal offence in New Zealand?
rows.result: Referendum failed. Petition successful— referendum held by postal ballot between 31 July and 21 August 2009. (56.09% turnout - 87.4% no; 11.98% yes)

rows.question_proposed: Should all citizens initiated referenda be binding on the New Zealand Government?
rows.question_determined: Should the results of all citizens initiated referenda be binding on the New Zealand Government?

rows.question_proposed: Should the minimum wage be raised to $15 an hour and then in steps over the next three years until it reaches two-thirds of the average ordinary time hourly rate as recommended by the 1973 Royal Commission into Social Security?
rows.question_determined: Should the adult minimum wage be raised in steps over the next three years, starting with an immediate rise to $15 per hour, until it reaches 66% of the average total hourly earnings as defined in the Quarterly Employment Survey?

rows.question_proposed: Should Citizens Initiated Referenda seeking to repeal or amend a law be binding?
rows.question_determined: Should Parliament be required to pass legislation that implements the majority result of a citizens initiated referendum where that result supports a law change?

rows.sponsor: Dr Muriel Newman and Dr Hugh Barr
rows.question_proposed: Should the Marine and Coastal Area Act be repealed to restore Crown ownership of the foreshore and seabed?
rows.question_determined: Should the Marine and Coastal Area (Takutai Moana) Act 2011 be replaced by legislation that restores Crown ownership of the foreshore and seabed?

rows.question_proposed: Do you support the Government selling up to 49% of Meridian Energy, Mighty River Power, Genesis Power, Solid Energy and Air New Zealand?
rows.question_determined: Do you support the Government selling up to 49% of Meridian Energy, Mighty River Power, Genesis Power, Solid Energy and Air New Zealand?
rows.result: Referendum failed. Petition successful— referendum held by postal ballot between 22 November 2013 and 13 December 2013. (45.07% turnout - 67.3% no; 32.4% yes)

rows.question_proposed: Should the North Shore establish as an independent city state to demonstrate a new economic model at the heart of New Zealand?
rows.question_determined: Should the North Shore establish as an independent city state to demonstrate a new economic model at the heart of New Zealand?

rows.question_proposed: Do you agree that ALL cruel and inhumane poisons be prohibited – including 1080 (sodium monofluoroacetate), brodifacoum, pindone, PAPP and cholecalciferol – because they inflict such intense and prolonged suffering that their use can never be justified?
rows.question_determined: Should New Zealand stop using all cruel and inhumane poisons, such as 1080, brodifacoum, and PAPP, to kill wildlife, because these toxic substances inflict intense and prolonged, unjustifiable suffering on all animals, including native birds, pets, and livestock?
